# MiaoYan (妙言)

> A lightweight, local-first Markdown note-taking app for Mac, iPhone and iPad, built natively with Swift 6.

Official website: https://miaoyan.app/ (also in Simplified Chinese /zh/, Traditional Chinese /tw/, Japanese /ja/, Korean /ko/, German /de/, French /fr/ and Spanish /es/)
Source code: https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan
App Store (Mac, iPhone and iPad in one purchase): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759252269
Author: Tw93, https://tw93.fun/

## Who it is for

MiaoYan is for people who want a focused, native writing app on Mac, iPhone and iPad that keeps ordinary Markdown files in a folder they choose. It does not collect note data. iCloud Drive, Nutstore, Dropbox, or another file-sync client can sync that folder when needed.

## Key capabilities

- Pure Markdown editing with a separate real-time preview
- Split editor and preview with 60fps bidirectional scroll sync
- Wikilinks and backlinks
- LaTeX math, plus Mermaid, PlantUML and Markmap diagrams
- Version history, auto-formatting, keyboard shortcuts, and dark mode
- Markdown presentation mode and a command-line interface
- Native Swift 6 app with no Electron runtime
- Requires macOS 12.0 or later; the iPhone and iPad apps require iOS 18.0 or iPadOS 18.0 or later

## Installation

- Mac app source code (MIT): https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan
- App Store: one purchase covers the Mac, iPhone and iPad apps, with automatic updates

The Mac app's source code is open on GitHub and keeps being developed. The iPhone and iPad apps are not open source, so they ship on the App Store together with the Mac app. On every device MiaoYan opens the same notes folder, for example one in iCloud Drive.

## Comparisons

Compared with Typora, MiaoYan does not use a WYSIWYG editor. It keeps the Markdown source and preview separate for people who want direct control of the file.

Compared with Obsidian, MiaoYan has no Electron runtime and is not centered on a plugin ecosystem. It favors a smaller set of built-in writing features and local Markdown files.

## Blog

English posts are at https://miaoyan.app/blog/ and Chinese ones at https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/.

- [Choosing a Markdown editor for Mac](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-editor-for-mac/): What to check in a Mac Markdown editor: plain files, WYSIWYG or split preview, math, sync and speed, with Typora, Obsidian, VS Code and MiaoYan compared.
- [Markdown cheat sheet: CommonMark, GFM and extensions](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-cheat-sheet/): The Markdown syntax you actually use, with examples, what CommonMark and GFM each define, and what MiaoYan renders on top.
- [LaTeX math in Markdown: syntax, KaTeX and pitfalls](https://miaoyan.app/blog/latex-math-in-markdown/): Write inline and block math in Markdown, use common LaTeX constructs, avoid dollar and underscore pitfalls, and see how MiaoYan renders KaTeX.
- [Mermaid diagrams in Markdown: flowchart, sequence, Gantt](https://miaoyan.app/blog/mermaid-diagrams-in-markdown/): Draw flowcharts, sequence and Gantt diagrams with fenced Mermaid blocks, plus PlantUML and Markmap, and what MiaoYan renders offline.
- [Markdown to slides: --- separators and MiaoYan PPT mode](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-to-slides/): Turn a Markdown note into a slide deck with --- separators, configure reveal.js options, and compare Marp, reveal.js and Slidev.
- [Markdown to PDF on Mac](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-to-pdf-mac/): Print a MiaoYan note to a fixed A4 PDF, and switch to Pandoc, Typora, VS Code, or the Mac print dialog for paper size and margins.
- [Typora alternative for Mac: split preview with MiaoYan](https://miaoyan.app/blog/typora-alternative-mac/): Why people leave Typora, WYSIWYG versus split preview, what carries over (files, math, images) and where each app is stronger.
- [Local-first Markdown notes: keep them as plain files](https://miaoyan.app/blog/local-first-markdown-notes/): Why plain Markdown files in your own folder beat a locked-in notes app, what it costs, and how MiaoYan reads the folder you choose.
- [Sync Markdown notes across devices without a sync service](https://miaoyan.app/blog/sync-markdown-notes-across-devices/): Use iCloud Drive, Nutstore, Dropbox or git to sync a Markdown notes folder, set MiaoYan's Note Location, and avoid conflict copies.
- [Wikilinks and backlinks in Markdown notes](https://miaoyan.app/blog/wikilinks-and-backlinks/): How [[wikilinks]] differ from normal Markdown links, what MiaoYan supports, how backlinks are built, and the portability trade-offs.
- [Markdown notes from the terminal with the miao CLI](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-notes-from-terminal/): Install the miao CLI, learn open, new, search, list and cat, script them, and use them with AI coding agents and the MiaoYan skill.
- [A lighter Obsidian alternative for Mac](https://miaoyan.app/blog/obsidian-alternative-mac/): What MiaoYan has and leaves out compared with Obsidian, how to open a vault, and which syntax carries over.
- [Markdown note version history: MiaoYan, Time Machine, git](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-note-version-history/): How MiaoYan saves and restores note versions, where they live, their limits, and how Time Machine and git cover what it does not.
- [Export Apple Notes as Markdown and open the files](https://miaoyan.app/blog/apple-notes-to-markdown/): macOS Tahoe can export a Notes note as Markdown. Sequoia exports PDF only. Check the file, then open it in MiaoYan.
- [A Bear alternative for Mac: plain Markdown files](https://miaoyan.app/blog/bear-alternative-mac/): Export Bear notes to Markdown, move them into folders MiaoYan reads, and see what you lose without tags and gain with plain files.
- [Chinese-English spacing in Markdown notes](https://miaoyan.app/blog/chinese-english-spacing/): Why Chinese writers add a space around Latin text and digits, the exceptions, and how MiaoYan's Clean Typography command applies it without touching code.
- [CommonMark vs GFM: which Markdown flavor to write](https://miaoyan.app/blog/commonmark-vs-gfm/): What CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown each define, what apps add on top, which layer MiaoYan renders, and a test file to check any editor.
- [Markdown code blocks: fences, language tags and nesting](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-code-blocks/): Write fenced and inline code in Markdown, nest a fence inside a fence, tag languages and diff blocks, and see what MiaoYan's preview highlights.
- [Markdown collapsible sections with details and summary](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-collapsible-sections/): Write a collapsible section in Markdown with details and summary, keep Markdown working inside it, and see how MiaoYan previews and exports it.
- [Markdown escape characters: backslash, entities and code spans](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-escape-characters/): Which characters a Markdown backslash escapes, when you need it, entities and code spans as alternatives, and the dollar-sign trap in MiaoYan.
- [Markdown footnotes: syntax, support and fallbacks](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-footnotes/): Write [^1] footnotes and definitions, see where GitHub, Pandoc and MiaoYan V4.5.0 render them, and fix footnotes that show as plain text.
- [Markdown front matter: YAML, TOML and MiaoYan](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-front-matter/): Write YAML or TOML front matter for Hugo, Jekyll and Astro, see how GitHub shows it, and what MiaoYan V4.5.0 hides in preview and export.
- [Markdown images: syntax, size and broken paths](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-images/): Insert images, set width with HTML, keep paths from breaking, and see how MiaoYan V4.5.0 stores, previews and exports images.
- [Markdown line breaks: soft, hard and MiaoYan's setting](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-line-breaks/): Why a single newline vanishes in Markdown, how backslash, two spaces and <br> differ, and what MiaoYan's Line Break setting changes in preview and export.
- [Markdown links and anchors: inline, reference, headings](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-links-and-anchors/): Inline, reference and autolinks, spaces in URLs, heading anchors on GitHub, and how MiaoYan's preview handles fragments and relative links.
- [Markdown on iPad: files, sync and editors](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-on-ipad/): What an iPad Markdown setup needs, how MiaoYan opens your Mac's iCloud Drive folder, what to check when a note is missing, and other editors.
- [Markdown tables: alignment, pipes and line breaks](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-tables/): Write a Markdown table, align columns, escape pipes, break lines in cells, handle wide tables in MiaoYan, and fall back to HTML for merged cells.
- [Markdown task lists and checkboxes: syntax and pitfalls](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-task-lists/): Write - [ ] and - [x] task lists, nest them, know where they render, how MiaoYan toggles a box in the source, and find open tasks with ripgrep.
- [Markmap mind maps from a Markdown outline](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markmap-mind-maps/): Turn headings and lists into a mind map with a markmap fence, what MiaoYan renders offline, which options apply, and how it differs from Mermaid.
- [PlantUML in Markdown: fences, server rendering and privacy](https://miaoyan.app/blog/plantuml-in-markdown/): Write sequence, class and activity diagrams in a plantuml fence, how MiaoYan renders them with plantuml.com, the privacy cost, and local or Mermaid options.
- [What is Markdown? A plain-text way to format](https://miaoyan.app/blog/what-is-markdown/): What Markdown is, where it came from, the ten marks that cover most writing, how it becomes HTML, what it cannot do, and a first note in MiaoYan.

- [Mac 上怎么选 Markdown 编辑器](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-editor-for-mac/): 从纯文件、所见即所得、公式图表、同步和性能几方面比较 Typora、Obsidian、VS Code 与妙言。
- [Markdown 语法速查与 GFM 差异](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-cheat-sheet/): 常用 Markdown 语法加示例，区分 CommonMark、GFM 与应用扩展，并说明妙言实际能渲染什么。
- [Markdown 里写 LaTeX 公式](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/latex-math-in-markdown/): 行内与块级公式的写法、常用 LaTeX 结构、美元符号和下划线的坑，以及妙言如何用 KaTeX 渲染。
- [Markdown 里画 Mermaid 图](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/mermaid-diagrams-in-markdown/): 用围栏代码块画流程图、时序图和甘特图，对比 PlantUML 与 Markmap，并说明妙言哪些图离线可用。
- [Markdown 转幻灯片：用 --- 分页](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-to-slides/): 用 --- 把笔记分成幻灯片，配置 reveal.js 选项，并比较妙言 PPT 模式与 Marp、Slidev。
- [在 Mac 上把 Markdown 转成 PDF](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-to-pdf-mac/): 妙言把笔记印成固定的 A4 PDF。要改纸张或边距，用 Pandoc、Typora 或别的应用打印。
- [Mac 上的 Typora 替代品](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/typora-alternative-mac/): 为什么有人离开 Typora，所见即所得与分栏预览的取舍，笔记、公式和图片能带走什么，以及两者各自强在哪里。
- [本地优先的 Markdown 笔记怎么管](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/local-first-markdown-notes/): 为什么把笔记存成自己文件夹里的纯 Markdown 文件，要付出什么，以及妙言怎么读取你选的文件夹。
- [跨设备同步 Markdown 笔记的几种做法](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/sync-markdown-notes-across-devices/): 用 iCloud 云盘、坚果云、Dropbox 或 git 同步笔记文件夹，在妙言里设置笔记位置，并避开冲突副本。
- [Markdown 笔记里的 Wikilink 与反向链接](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/wikilinks-and-backlinks/): [[wikilink]] 和普通 Markdown 链接有什么不同，妙言支持什么，反向链接怎么生成，可移植性上要付出什么。
- [在终端里使用 Markdown 笔记：miao 命令行](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-notes-from-terminal/): 安装 miao，掌握 open、new、search、list、cat，写脚本，并配合 AI 编码 Agent 和妙言 skill 使用。
- [Mac 上更轻的 Obsidian 替代品](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/obsidian-alternative-mac/): 妙言和 Obsidian 相比有什么、没有什么，怎么打开 vault，以及哪些语法能带过来。
- [Markdown 笔记的版本历史怎么用](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-note-version-history/): 妙言如何保存和恢复笔记版本、存在哪里、有什么限制，以及 Time Machine 和 git 怎么补上它覆盖不到的部分。
- [把备忘录导出为 Markdown 再交给妙言](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/apple-notes-to-markdown/): Tahoe 可把备忘录导出为 Markdown，Sequoia 只能导出 PDF。核对文件后放进妙言打开的文件夹。
- [Mac 上的 Bear 替代品：纯 Markdown 文件](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/bear-alternative-mac/): 把 Bear 笔记导出成 Markdown，搬进妙言读取的文件夹，说清没有标签的代价和纯文件的好处。
- [Markdown 里的中英文空格](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/chinese-english-spacing/): 为什么中英文之间要加空格、有哪些例外，以及妙言的「排版净化」怎么处理又不碰代码。
- [CommonMark 与 GFM 有什么区别](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/commonmark-vs-gfm/): CommonMark、GFM 与应用扩展各管什么，妙言实现到哪一层，以及检查任意应用的测试文件。
- [Markdown 代码块：围栏、语言标记与嵌套](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-code-blocks/): 围栏与行内代码的写法、围栏嵌套、语言名与 diff，以及妙言预览实际能高亮什么。
- [Markdown 折叠：details 与 summary 的写法](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-collapsible-sections/): 用 details 和 summary 写折叠区，让里面的 Markdown 正常渲染，以及妙言的预览与导出表现。
- [Markdown 转义字符：反斜杠、实体与行内代码](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-escape-characters/): 反斜杠能转义哪些字符、什么时候需要，实体和行内代码的替代做法，以及妙言里的美元符号。
- [Markdown 脚注怎么写，哪里能渲染](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-footnotes/): 脚注的 [^1] 写法、命名与多段落脚注，以及 GitHub、Pandoc、妙言 V4.5.0 的支持情况和排错。
- [Markdown front matter 写法与渲染](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-front-matter/): YAML 与 TOML front matter 的写法、各生成器常用键、GitHub 的显示，以及妙言 V4.5.0 的处理。
- [Markdown 图片：插入、调整大小与路径](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-images/): 图片语法、用 HTML 设宽度、路径为何会坏，以及妙言 V4.5.0 的图片存放、预览和导出行为。
- [Markdown 换行：软换行、硬换行与妙言的设置](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-line-breaks/): 单个回车为什么不换行，反斜杠、两个空格和 <br> 有何区别，以及妙言的换行方式如何影响预览和导出。
- [Markdown 链接与锚点：行内、引用和标题跳转](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-links-and-anchors/): 行内、引用式与自动链接，网址里的空格和括号，GitHub 的标题锚点，以及妙言预览如何处理片段和相对链接。
- [iPad 上写 Markdown：文件、同步和编辑器](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-on-ipad/): iPad 写 Markdown 需要什么，妙言怎么打开 Mac 的 iCloud 文件夹，笔记没出现时怎么查。
- [Markdown 表格：对齐、竖线与单元格换行](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-tables/): 表格写法、列对齐、转义竖线、单元格内换行，妙言里宽表格的表现，以及合并单元格时退回 HTML。
- [Markdown 待办列表与复选框写法](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-task-lists/): - [ ] 与 - [x] 的写法、嵌套、各处渲染差异，妙言点击复选框如何改写原文，以及用 ripgrep 找未完成事项。
- [用 Markdown 大纲画 Markmap 思维导图](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markmap-mind-maps/): 用 markmap 围栏把标题和列表画成思维导图，妙言离线渲染的行为、选项限制，以及和 Mermaid mindmap 的区别。
- [Markdown 里写 PlantUML：围栏、服务器渲染与隐私](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/plantuml-in-markdown/): 用 plantuml 围栏画时序图、类图和活动图，妙言如何经 plantuml.com 渲染、隐私代价，以及本地渲染和 Mermaid 的替代做法。
- [Markdown 是什么](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/what-is-markdown/): Markdown 的来历、覆盖大多数写作的十个记号、怎么变成 HTML、不擅长什么，以及在妙言里写第一篇。
